item.description: Section 166.241, Florida Statutes, requires the Town of Fort Myers Beach to maintain a balanced budget for each fund and allows a municipality up to 60 days after the end of the fiscal year to amend the prior year’s budget. The FY2026 Adopted Budget included a transfer of $581,380 ($48,448.33 per month) from the General Fund to the General Debt Service Fund. In May 2024, the Town drew additional loan funds, which increased the annual payment to $581,468.40 ($48,455.70 per month). This increase was not reflected in the FY2026 Budget. This amendment adjusts the General Fund and the General Debt Service Fund by $88.40 (rounded to $89) to bring the FY2026 Budget into compliance with Florida Statutes.

item.description: This item is being presented for discussion and approval. The parcel under consideration creates a barrier that prevents the property owner from properly repairing their seawall on the property. By relinquishing any claim the Town may have on this parcel, the Town will allow Christopher Lee Johnson and Mary Susan Johnson to proceed with the repairs necessary to restore their seawall. The conveyance shall be by quitclaim deed providing no assurances as to the Town's legal right to the property. This action minimizes the Town's liability regarding title litigation over the submerged lands.
